name: test-coverage-flow
original_weak_prompt: increase the test coverage for at least 5% and if your new tests didn't find any regressions, your tests are shit
returned_compiled_prompt:
Goal:
[TASK]

Context:
[CONTEXT_TARGET]

Constraints:
- Increase coverage in [COVERAGE_SCOPE] by at least [COVERAGE_THRESHOLD]; do not modify unrelated [SCOPE_ELEMENTS], and do not accept tests that only add line hits without asserting real behavior.

Execution:
- Measure the current coverage in [COVERAGE_SCOPE] first, then add one [UNIT] at a time that targets an uncovered behavioral path—each new test must be able to fail on a realistic regression, not just reach a line—and continue until [DONE_CONDITION].

Validation:
- Run [VALIDATION], show the before and after coverage delta for [COVERAGE_SCOPE], and confirm that at least one new test fails when the behavior it targets is removed or broken; a suite that only adds coverage without ever catching a regression is not acceptable.

Review:
- Confirm coverage in [COVERAGE_SCOPE] increased by at least [COVERAGE_THRESHOLD] and that [STABLE_INTERFACE] is still covered; reject any new test that cannot detect at least one realistic regression—tests that only inflate coverage without proving behavioral correctness must be rewritten or removed.

placeholder_resolution.CONTEXT_TARGET: the engine selection and pattern-weighting paths in internal/engine, currently at ~62% coverage
placeholder_resolution.DONE_CONDITION: go test ./... -cover shows internal/engine coverage ≥ 67% and at least one new test fails when a targeted branch is removed
placeholder_resolution.SCOPE_ELEMENTS: packages, CLI surface, JSON fixture files, and example flows
placeholder_resolution.STABLE_INTERFACE: the optimize JSON contract, category registry shape, and existing CLI flag behavior
placeholder_resolution.TASK: Increase test coverage in internal/engine by at least 5 percentage points while ensuring every new test can detect a realistic regression.
placeholder_resolution.UNIT: uncovered behavioral branch or error path

final_agent_handoff:
Goal:
Increase test coverage in internal/engine by at least 5 percentage points while ensuring every new test can detect a realistic regression.

Context:
the engine selection and pattern-weighting paths in internal/engine, currently at ~62% coverage

Constraints:
- Increase coverage in internal/engine by at least 5%; do not modify unrelated packages, CLI surface, JSON fixture files, and example flows, and do not accept tests that only add line hits without asserting real behavior.

Execution:
- Measure the current coverage in internal/engine first, then add one uncovered behavioral branch or error path at a time that targets an uncovered behavioral path—each new test must be able to fail on a realistic regression, not just reach a line—and continue until go test ./... -cover shows internal/engine coverage ≥ 67% and at least one new test fails when a targeted branch is removed.

Validation:
- Run go test ./... -cover -coverprofile=coverage.out && go tool cover -func=coverage.out, show the before and after coverage delta for internal/engine, and confirm that at least one new test fails when the behavior it targets is removed or broken; a suite that only adds coverage without ever catching a regression is not acceptable.

Review:
- Confirm coverage in internal/engine increased by at least 5% and that the optimize JSON contract, category registry shape, and existing CLI flag behavior is still covered; reject any new test that cannot detect at least one realistic regression—tests that only inflate coverage without proving behavioral correctness must be rewritten or removed.
